about: Lemonade, Inc. provides various insurance products in the United States, Europe, and the United Kingdom. The company provides renters and homeowners, building, car, pet, and life insurance products, as well as landlord insurance products. It also offers insurance for stolen or damaged property, personal liability that protects its customers if they are responsible for an accident or damage to another person or their property, and pet insurance.
